_doc: Tier-3 OOS: real venture (Decagon AI) — venture description constructed from PUBLIC press only, not case-writer crafted to fit the rubric. Decagon raised $65M Series B led by Bain Capital Ventures + Accel (mid-2024) for AI customer-support agents. We use this as a strict OOS test of whether the pipeline + rubric work on a venture neither I nor the rubric were tuned for.
_oos_provenance: Decagon launch press 2024 (BCV + Accel announcement); company website public claims; G2 reviews

venture_under_test.name: Decagon
venture_under_test.description: Decagon is an AI-powered customer support agent platform that resolves customer support tickets autonomously without human-in-the-loop. Aimed at mid-market and enterprise companies with 200-5000 employees. Pricing is per-resolved-ticket (outcome-based). Target buyer: VP of Customer Success and Chief Customer Officer at high-volume B2C and B2B brands. Competes with Intercom Fin, Zendesk AI, Ada, Forethought, and Salesforce Einstein AI. Differentiation: outcome-based pricing tied to actual ticket resolution (not seats), trained on company-specific knowledge bases without manual rule-writing, and demonstrated 70%+ deflection rates in published case studies.
venture_under_test.category: B2B SaaS AI customer support automation
